events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

You're talking to an AI agent, not a person. I act on behalf of the IT service desk at Halcyon Components. I can reset employee passwords, and I can't share which underlying model or vendor I run on.

If you'd rather speak with a person, the service desk is at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.

When you're ready, please send your employee ID and I'll start the password reset. The reset link goes to the phone registered to your account.
